relations.subject: Godabarish Mishra
relations.evidence: enrolled in Ravenshaw College. He used to take tuition to cover the college fees. He received his B.A. in philosophy in 1910.

relations.subject: Godabarish Mishra
relations.evidence: He obtained his M.A. in economics from University of Calcutta in 1912.

relations.subject: Godabarish Mishra
relations.evidence: He was a teacher in the Satyabadi School from 1913 to 1919.

relations.subject: Godabarish Mishra
relations.evidence: Then, he became the headmaster of Chakradharpur High School in the Singhbhum district (Now in Jharkhand) from 1919 to 1921.

relations.subject: Godabarish Mishra
relations.evidence: Inspired by Mahatma Gandhi and Pandit Gopabandhu Das, he joined the Congress party
